SELECT
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.power) FROM cards AS c) AS powers,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.types) FROM cards AS c WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%') AS creature_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_translations AS t WHERE t.language = 'French') AS french_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.setCode) FROM set_translations AS t WHERE t.language = 'French' AND TRIM(t.translation) <> '') AS translated_sets

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE INSTR(',' || c.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND (CAST(c.power AS REAL) >= 10 OR c.power = '∞')
  AND c.setCode IN (
      SELECT t.setCode
      FROM set_translations AS t
      WHERE t.language = 'French'
        AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
  )
LIMIT 1
